scientific_fits.scope: Numerical engineering and frozen-checkpoint postprocessing; not a new fitting screen.

batchnorm.checkpoint_policy: Operator pins one immutable PR46 checkpoint and indexed ancestry before reading diagnostic outcomes. No automatic best/latest selection.
batchnorm.calibration_membership: 256 deterministically selected eligible train sequences; seed1001; all rows; no labels
batchnorm.method: Sequential layerwise pooled eval-input moments; upstream recalibrated buffers applied before downstream pass
batchnorm.eval: All official valid is_scored rows after warmup99; pooled global_wp_clip2_v1
batchnorm.output: Separate inference-only candidate checkpoint; never overwrite or resume original

interpretation.validation: exposed official valid, approximate feature-connected overlap exclusions; no independently proven calendar chronology
interpretation.parity: Numerical equivalence required, not bitwise equality or same optimization trajectory guaranteed
interpretation.bn_result: Exploratory checkpoint-conditional diagnostic; no significance/public transfer claim
interpretation.pipeline_speedup: Full epoch includes data, monitoring and validation; synthetic update timing is not epoch speedup
